definition: available at a lower price than usual
example: Winter boots are on sale for 40 percent off this week only.

definition: not available in a store because all have been sold
example: The blender I wanted was out of stock, so the store ordered one for me.

definition: a store's rules about taking back items customers have bought
example: Check the return policy before buying electronics; some stores only allow 15 days.

definition: to return something you bought and get a different item instead
example: Can I exchange these shoes for a larger size?

definition: something bought for less than its usual price; a good deal
example: At $50, this used bike was a real bargain.

definition: an amount taken off the usual price
example: Students get a 10 percent discount if they show their student card.

definition: to sell an item at the same lower price a competitor offers
vi: khớp giá (bán bằng giá thấp hơn của đối thủ)
example: The store agreed to price match the TV after I showed them the online ad.

definition: to compare prices at different stores before buying
vi: so sánh giá ở nhiều nơi trước khi mua
example: It pays to shop around for car insurance and internet plans.
collocations: shop around for the best price

definition: not expensive; suitable for people with limited money
vi: phù hợp túi tiền, giá rẻ
example: We found a budget-friendly sofa that still looks stylish.

definition: costing more than it is worth
vi: đắt quá mức, giá bị đội lên
example: Food at the airport is overpriced, so I always bring my own snacks.

definition: good enough to justify the price
example: The jacket was expensive, but it was worth the money because it lasted ten winters.

definition: made by a well-known company
example: Store brands are often just as good as brand-name products but cost less.

definition: previously owned and used by someone else
vi: đồ cũ, đã qua sử dụng
example: Buying second-hand furniture is cheaper and better for the environment.

definition: to buy something through a website or app
example: I usually order online and pick up the groceries at the store on my way home.
collocations: order online and pick up in store

definition: the money charged for bringing goods to your home
example: The delivery fee is waived for orders over $75.

definition: delivery with no extra charge
example: The website offers free shipping on all orders during the holiday season.

definition: ordered but not yet available, so it will be sent later
vi: (hàng) đang chờ nhập, đặt trước chưa có hàng
example: Your desk is backordered and should ship in about three weeks.

definition: a scheme that rewards regular customers with points or discounts
vi: chương trình khách hàng thân thiết
example: With the grocery store's loyalty program, I earn points I can use for free food.

definition: buying things suddenly without planning
vi: mua sắm bốc đồng, theo cảm hứng
example: Making a shopping list helps me avoid impulse buying at the supermarket.

definition: a piece of paper or email showing what you bought and paid
example: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the gift.

definition: the place in a store where you pay for your items
example: The line at the checkout was so long that I used the self-serve machines.

definition: tax added to the price of goods, such as GST and PST in BC
example: The price on the tag doesn't include sales tax, so expect to pay about 12 percent more.

definition: a sale with very low prices to get rid of old stock
vi: đợt bán xả hàng, thanh lý
example: I bought patio furniture at a clearance sale at the end of September.

definition: able to last a long time without breaking
example: These hiking boots are more expensive, but they're far more durable.

definition: very good; made to a high standard
example: The farmers' market sells high-quality local produce at fair prices.

definition: a metal basket on wheels in a store, or the list of items you plan to buy online
vi: xe đẩy mua hàng; giỏ hàng (khi mua online)
example: I added the jacket to my shopping cart but waited for a promo code before paying.

definition: a small label on a product that shows how much it costs
example: The price tag said $40, but the cashier charged me $55.

definition: a piece of paper or digital code that gives you a discount
example: I clipped a coupon from the flyer and saved ten dollars on diapers.

definition: to put on clothes or shoes in a store to see if they fit
example: Always try on winter boots with thick socks before you buy them.

definition: a small room in a clothing store where you try on clothes
example: There was a long line for the fitting room during the Boxing Day sale.

definition: a passage between rows of shelves in a store
vi: lối đi giữa các kệ hàng
example: You'll find the rice and noodles in aisle seven, next to the sauces.

definition: the activity of buying food and household items
example: We do our grocery shopping on Sunday mornings when the store is quieter.

definition: a sale of used household items that a family holds at their home, often in the garage or driveway
vi: bán đồ cũ tại nhà (bày ở gara hoặc trước sân)
example: We sold our old toys and kitchen things at a garage sale last Saturday.

definition: a deal where you receive a second item at no cost when you buy one
example: The pharmacy has a buy one, get one free deal on vitamins this week.
collocations: buy one, get one free offer
buy one, get one free deal
a buy one, get one free promotion

definition: to look at items in a store or online without a clear plan to buy
example: I like to browse the bookstore for a while before I choose something.

definition: a service where you order online and staff bring the items to your car
vi: nhận hàng tại xe (đặt online, nhân viên mang ra tận xe)
example: Curbside pickup saves me time when I have the kids in the car.

definition: to reduce the price of something
vi: hạ giá, giảm giá (một món hàng)
example: The store marked down all its patio furniture by 30 percent in September.

definition: a code you type when ordering online to get a discount
example: Enter the promo code at checkout to get free shipping on your first order.

definition: a special price or deal that is only available for a short period
example: The gym's limited-time offer ends on Friday, so I signed up today.
collocations: take advantage of a limited-time offer

definition: extra costs that are not obvious when you first agree to buy something
example: The phone plan looked cheap, but there were hidden costs for data and activation.

definition: a partial refund a store gives when an item you bought goes on sale soon afterwards
vi: điều chỉnh giá (hoàn lại phần chênh lệch khi hàng vừa mua bị giảm giá)
example: The TV went on sale a week after I bought it, so I asked for a price adjustment.

definition: not included with a product, so it must be bought on its own
vi: bán riêng (không kèm theo sản phẩm)
example: The camera is on sale, but the memory card is sold separately.

definition: a person whose job is to take payment from customers in a store
example: The cashier asked if I had a loyalty card before she scanned my items.

definition: something that costs much more than it should
vi: bị chặt chém, giá cắt cổ
example: Twenty dollars for a sandwich at the airport is a total rip-off.

definition: to buy a large amount of something so you have enough for later
example: We stock up on canned food and water before the winter storms.
collocations: stock up before the sale ends

definition: expensive
example: The restaurant is a bit pricey, but the food is excellent.

definition: opinions written by customers about something they bought
vi: đánh giá sản phẩm (của khách hàng)
example: I read the product reviews before ordering, and most buyers said it broke easily.

definition: to be sold together with something else
example: The vacuum comes with three extra brushes and a two-year warranty.

definition: to fill a store with new supplies of a product
vi: nhập thêm hàng, bổ sung hàng
example: The manager said they would restock the shelves on Thursday morning.

definition: to order a product before it is available for sale
example: My son pre-ordered the new video game so it would arrive on release day.

definition: a card with a set amount of money that can be spent at a particular store
example: My coworkers gave me a gift card to a local bookstore for my birthday.

definition: a number you use to follow where your package is during delivery
vi: mã vận đơn (để theo dõi gói hàng)
example: The seller emailed me a tracking number so I could see when the parcel would arrive.

definition: to buy a large quantity of something at once, usually to pay less
vi: mua số lượng lớn (để rẻ hơn)
example: We buy in bulk at a warehouse store, which saves money but needs a lot of storage space.

definition: the lowest and highest prices that something costs or that you will pay
example: What's your price range? We have several models under $500.

definition: a product sold under the store's own name, usually cheaper than famous brands
vi: hàng nhãn riêng của cửa hàng/siêu thị
example: The store brand cereal tastes almost the same and costs much less.

definition: an item that cannot be returned or exchanged after you buy it
example: Be careful: everything on this rack is final sale, so check the size first.
collocations: all clearance items are final sale

definition: to spend a lot of money on something special, usually as a treat
vi: vung tiền, chi mạnh tay (cho một thứ)
example: After saving all year, we decided to splurge on a weekend in Tofino.

definition: good value for the money you spend (informal)
vi: đáng đồng tiền bát gạo, giá trị cao so với tiền bỏ ra
example: If you want more bang for your buck, the bigger package is the better choice.
collocations: get more bang for your buck
the best bang for your buck
a lot of bang for your buck

definition: to be extremely expensive
vi: tốn cả gia tài, rất đắt
example: Fixing the transmission would cost a fortune, so we bought a used car instead.
collocations: doesn't have to cost a fortune
synonyms: cost an arm and a leg

definition: a person who buys goods or services
example: Consumers are paying more attention to where their food comes from.

definition: a business that sells goods directly to the public
example: Several large retailers have closed stores in the mall this year.

definition: goods that are bought and sold
example: Damaged merchandise must be returned within 14 days with the receipt.

definition: expensive and aimed at wealthy customers
example: The new upscale grocery store on Main Street is beautiful but expensive.

definition: a cheap copy of a famous brand's product
example: The bag looked like a designer one, but it was just a knock-off.

term: at a fraction of the cost
definition: for much less money than something else costs
vi: với giá rẻ hơn rất nhiều
example: Thrift stores sell good-quality clothes at a fraction of the cost of new ones.
collocations: at a fraction of the cost of
available at a fraction of the cost
get the same results at a fraction of the cost

definition: to argue about the price of something to try to make it lower
example: You can often haggle a little at garage sales and flea markets.

definition: to pay more than usual to get something better or special
vi: trả thêm tiền để có (thứ tốt hơn)
example: Many shoppers are willing to pay a premium for locally grown produce.
collocations: willing to pay a premium for

definition: the official price shown on a product, especially a car, before discounts
example: Nobody pays the full sticker price at that dealership; they always offer a discount.

definition: a feeling of regret after buying something, especially something expensive
example: I had buyer's remorse right after I bought the expensive treadmill.

definition: a website where many sellers offer goods to buyers
vi: sàn thương mại điện tử, chợ trực tuyến
example: I sold our old crib on an online marketplace within two days.

definition: a sudden or large increase in price
example: Shoppers are frustrated by another price hike on dairy products.

definition: a very large store, usually part of a chain, that sells many kinds of products
vi: đại siêu thị (cửa hàng chuỗi rất lớn)
example: Big-box stores are cheaper, but local shops offer more personal service.

definition: careful about spending money and avoiding waste
vi: tiết kiệm, chi tiêu dè sẻn
example: My grandparents were very frugal and never threw anything away.

definition: spending or costing much more than is reasonable
example: Buying a new car every two years seems extravagant to me.

definition: much too high (used about prices or costs)
example: Some stores charge exorbitant fees for delivering furniture to the suburbs.

definition: the amount a seller adds to the cost of a product to make a profit
vi: phần lời cộng thêm vào giá vốn
example: There is a huge markup on bottled water at concerts and sports games.

definition: able to judge quality well and choose carefully
vi: sành sỏi, tinh tường (biết chọn lựa)
example: The boutique attracts discerning shoppers who care about quality more than price.
